properties.title: Approximate reconstructed holdings of Hugh de Gournay III
properties.usage_note: Historical research aid only; approximate modern-reference reconstruction.
properties.derivation_summary: Core polygon is an inferred schematic for the older Gournay lordship west/immediately around the Epte near Gournay-en-Bray. Acquisition polygon is a tighter schematic reconstruction of the Beauvaisis / '24 villages' block using the preserved place-list and modern anchor communes such as Saint-Quentin-des-Pres, Songeons, Loueuse, Sully, and Hericourt-sur-Therain. The Epte feature is schematic and not an exact river trace.

properties.name: Older Gournay core
properties.historical_basis: Inferred from the pre-existing Gournay lordship prior to the Beauvaisis additions.
properties.interpretation_note: Approximate polygon for visualization and reuse.

properties.name: Beauvaisis acquisitions / '24 villages'
properties.historical_basis: Reconstructed from the preserved 'Conquets Hue de Gournay' place-list and modern commune anchors.
properties.interpretation_note: Not a surveyed medieval boundary; a compact modern-reference reconstruction.
